approval.basis: Independent exhaustive audit, separate clean-checkout rerun and raw-row aggregate review; no human observations.

claims.filter: family=all; budgetPercent in [25,50,75,100]; comparator=conditionFirst; investment controls excluded
limitations: Preregistered authored synthetic engineering suite; not a representative or held-out campus sample.
Equal-weight destinations are not people; assumed costs and modeled repairs are not construction outcomes.
Unknown routes provide no demonstrated access; unknown-cost candidates are excluded.
Objective omits hazard reduction, partial progress and mandatory-work constraints.
120 correlated budget cases arise from 30 networks; no significance or population claims.
Human study observations and measured time savings are outside this benchmark.
claims.wording: Across 30 authored synthetic networks and four budgets each, Curb exact yielded a scenario-weighted mean of 0.808 additional newly reachable destinations versus Condition-first, with 58 wins, 62 ties and 0 losses across 120 paired budget cases.
